question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'against'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence 'tomato products protect (2)____ some types of cancer. ' requires an appropriate word to be filled in the **blank number 2** from the given options.
 
• From the given context, we need protection against disease, and we use the preposition **'against' **in resistance to or defense from any disease.
 
 
• ***Example: **Active wearing of masks helps to **protect against** Covid-19 disease.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, from the context, protect 'against' is the correct construction here.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
